items.stem: A startup, "DataVitals," develops a mobile app that collects users' daily exercise data and heart rate readings. The app uses this raw input to generate weekly progress reports and securely store the information.

parts.label: i
parts.text: John is a user of the DataVitals app. He finds that the app crashes every time he tries to view his weekly report. Which staff role in the company is primarily responsible for providing immediate support for John?(1 mark)

parts.label: ii
parts.text:
The issue John reported is confirmed to be a bug in the DataVitals app's source code. Which staff role in the company is responsible for fixing this flaw?(1 mark)
The DataVitals app calculates a user's Body Mass Index (BMI). BMI is a measure that uses a person's weight and height to determine if they are underweight, normal weight, or overweight. The formula is: BMI = weight ÷ (height × height).

parts.label: b
parts.text:
Explain the role of each stage of the Input-Process-Output (IPO) cycle in determining the final BMI score.(3 marks)
Input
Collecting the raw data, i.e. ________________________.
Process
Output
Presenting the user with _______________________.

parts.label: c
parts.text:
The app uses John’s health data (e.g. BMI and heart rate) to display customised advertising for related product. What is the potential issue associated with this practice?(2 marks)
[--Answer:
(a) (i) Technical support.
(ii) Programmer / software engineer / software developer.
(b) Input: weight and height
Process: Calculates BMI using the formula.
Output: the final BMI score
(c) Violation of privacy / unauthorised use of sensitive data for commercial gain.
--]
